title: Binary Weighted DAC
text: N-bit DAC based on R-2R weighted resistor architecture, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Rising slew rate} sets Switch rising slew rate for DAC; {Number of bits}, {Input polarity} sets the polarity of input signal, {Use external start clock} sets the connect to external start conversion clock, {Conversion start frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of internal start conversion clock, {Reference (V)} sets the reference voltage, {Bias (V)} sets the bias voltage added to output, {Show ready port} enables ready port on block, {Enable linearity impairments} enables offset and gain errors in DAC, {Offset error} sets the shifts quantization steps by specific value, {Gain error} sets the error in slope of DAC transfer curve, {Enable timing impairments}, {Specify switch timing using} sets how DAC calculates switch timing Settling, {Settling time (s)} sets the time required for output, {Settling time tolerance (LSB)} sets the tolerance for calculating settling time and {Falling slew rate} sets the switch falling slew rate for DAC. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: digital
ports.summary: Digital input signal to DAC integer

ports.name: start
ports.summary: External clock to start conversion scalar

ports.name: ready
ports.summary: Indicates whether digital-to-analog conversion is complete scalar

params.name: Number of bits
params.values: Number of bits in input word 5 (default) | positive real integer

params.name: Input polarity
params.values: Polarity of input signal to DAC Bipolar (default) | Unipolar

params.name: Use external start clock
params.values: Connect to external start conversion clock on (default) | off

params.name: Conversion start frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency of internal start conversion clock 1e6 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Bias (V)
params.values: Bias voltage added to output 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Show ready port
params.values: Enable ready port on block off (default) | on

params.name: Enable linearity impairments
params.values: Enable offset and gain errors in DAC simulation on (default) | off

params.name: Offset error
params.values: Shifts quantization steps by specific value 0 LSB (default) | real scalar

params.name: Gain error
params.values: Error in slope of DAC transfer curve 0 LSB (default) | real scalar

params.name: Enable timing impairments
params.values: Enable timing impairments in DAC simulation on (default) | off

params.name: Specify switch timing using
params.values: Specify how DAC calculates switch timing Settling time (default) | Slew rate

params.name: Settling time (s)
params.values: Time required for output to settle 2e-7 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Settling time tolerance (LSB)
params.values: Tolerance for calculating settling time 0.5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Rising slew rate
params.values: Switch rising slew rate for DAC 5015625 (default) | positive real scalar | positive real vector

params.name: Falling slew rate
params.values: Switch falling slew rate for DAC -5015625 (default) | negative real scalar | negative real vector
